entries.speaker: Before Infiltrating a Palace
entries.en: Check your progress with the [clr 2]Hold Meeting[clr 27][n]option. Listen to your friends' opinions[n]and decide the best course of action.

entries.speaker: Before Infiltrating a Palace
entries.en: Selecting [clr 2]Infiltrate Palace[clr 27] will take you to[n]the Palace. You cannot purchase items while[n]in a Palace, so be sure you're well prepared.

entries.speaker: Before Infiltrating a Palace
entries.en: It will be nighttime when you return from a[n]Palace. If time runs out, it's [clr 2]game over[clr 27].[n]Keep an eye on the time remaining.
